name: togi-kinetic
about: TOGI's word-by-word titles, measured from his video (4.0 to 6.0 s): words snap on with no tween, one every 0.1 to 0.2 s with speech, white words behind him with a soft shadow, blue #0729FD words in front, one word tilted 35 degrees, then the whole set swaps at once. Give words, accent_words, tilt_words and breaks. Render layer=back and layer=front and put a Magic Mask cut-out of Michael between them.
